messages:
Samir R.: evening handoff in 30m. I'm primary until 23:00 UTC, Priya you'll be secondary. Quick access sanity before I drop: can everyone confirm PagerDuty, cross-account AWS assume-role, and Grafana Editor access?
María G.: confirmed PD ack, I'm in infra-prod schedule and can assign incidents. PD test: I just sent a test page (INC-TEST-900).
OpsBot: Incident created: INC-TEST-900 assigned to infra-prod, priority: P3, triggered by schedule test.
Priya S.: I can see PD, but quick check — I don't have the cross-account AWS role in the prod account. When I run the assume-role command I get AccessDenied.
Samir R.: ok Priya — which account ARN did you try? paste the command output.
Priya S.: here's what I used:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/RedwoodOncall --role-session-name priya-oncall
```
Response: An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/RedwoodOncall
Noah L.: that usually means the SAML mapping for your user group isn't in the target account's trust policy. We had one recent terraform drift in 987654321098.
Samir R.: María — can you validate the trust policy quickly? link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall/aws-crossacct-checks
María G.: checking... I see the trust policy includes the IdP for our SSO, but the group 'oncall' isn't listed. I can add it but need an approvals step; would take ~10-15m.
Priya S.: that would be a blocker if a real P1 hits and I can't assume role. Is there an interim fallback?
Samir R.: fallback: use Noah's personal emergency role (arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/RedwoodSREFallback) — Noah, are you OK sharing access for tonight? Prefer only if PD page escalates.
Noah L.: I can enable temporary session and give you a one-time MFA code via DM if needed. But prefer we fix trust policy asap. I'll open a quick PR: repo infra/aws-crossacct-trust, small terraform update.
Samir R.: thanks. Grafana next — can everyone confirm org membership and Editor permissions for the redwood-prod org? We need Editor to silence alerts and create snapshots.
María G.: I have Viewer only. Can't silence. I opened a support ticket last week but not resolved. Ticket: #SUP-4821.
Priya S.: I have Editor. No issues on Grafana for me.
Samir R.: María — for tonight, if a page requires silencing and you can't, Priya or I will take it. Also add a note in the handoff doc so on-call knows where to go. Handboook link: https://internal.redwood/handbook/oncall-handoff (copy to ops-confluence).
Oncall Rotations Bot: Reminder: Priya S. promoted to secondary rotation for 2026-03-14 23:00 UTC - 07:00 UTC.
Samir R.: runbook pointer for PD acknowledgement and escalation (paste to thread):
```
# PD quick ack and escalate
1) Open incident in PagerDuty web UI or `pd` cli
2) `pd incidents acknowledge <INC_ID>` to stop paging
3) If you need to add responders: `pd incidents add-note <INC_ID> --body "escalate to infra-sre @noah"`
4) If escalation needs AWS access, assume-role and run remediation playbooks in infra-runbooks repo
```
Priya S.: also adding a quick AWS cli snippet for assume-role that includes --duration-seconds for emergency session:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/RedwoodOncall --role-session-name oncall-session --duration-seconds 3600
```
Samir R.: and a Grafana tip: if you can view but not silence, you can still create a temporary dashboard snapshot and DM link to responder. Not ideal but better than nothing.
María G.: filing a runbook update: I'll add a small section 'Handoff access checklist' with these commands + ticket references. Will link PR in this thread.
Priya S.: one more thought — token-level cost/latency view in Console needs a separate permission (analytics.viewer). Not critical for mitigation but useful for post-incident debugging. Is that part of the org RBAC?
Noah L.: that's in the Console permissions matrix. I'll include it in the PR to make sure secondary gets analytics.viewer by default.
Samir R.: action items before handoff (summary):
- María to open PR to add 'oncall' group to AWS trust policy in 987654321098 (est 15m)
- Noah to add analytics.viewer to rotation defaults (est 30m)
- Priya to confirm PD ack flow (done) and verify fallback process with Noah if AWS remains blocked (standby)
- María to update runbook with commands and support ticket refs

Samir R.: passing primary to Priya at 23:00 UTC, I'll stay available for 30m after in case anything weird pops. If anything pages escalate to infra-sre and tag @Noah L.
Priya S.: taking primary at 23:00 UTC. Thanks Samir. I'll DM Noah if I hit the AssumeRole issue during an incident.
Samir R.: thanks team. leaving a short checklist in the PD incident note and in the handoff doc. Good handoff. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: nightly-handoff-check at 22:45 UTC will post this thread link to #eng-oncall.
